resources.string: Zad X uses this permission only to see which app is open (its name, never what is on the screen), so it can lock games and apps chosen by the parent during prayer time or until tasks are done, keep the Settings app for the parent only, and stop apps from being deleted without the parent when the parent turns that on. Phone and emergency calls are never locked. Nothing about the apps used leaves this phone.
Lets the parent stop Zad X from being deleted on this phone. Zad X asks for no other device controls: it cannot erase, lock or read anything. The parent can turn this off at any time in Zad X.
